newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's Vneshtorgbank to receive $120 mln credit.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Vneshtorgbank to receive $120 mln credit.

text.p: Russia's second biggest bank Vneshtorgbank said on Wednesday it had signed an agreement with an international banking consortium to receive an unconditional syndicated $120 million credit.
Vneshtorgbank will pay a spread of 3.7 percent over LIBOR on the two-year credit, the bank's press service said.
Barclay's Bank PLC subsidiary BZW will organise the credit, while Barclay's itself will act as agent. The 19 banks in the syndicate include banks from Western and Eastern Europe and Asia.
The Russian Central Bank is Vneshtorgbank's biggest shareholder.
